findings_and_refinements.status: Previously recorded 774 F088, independently reconnected to 95e; no additional unique count.
trace: pose.rs:34–46,64–70,147–157: public Move fields and Axis.set admit unconstrained floats; Move.apply applies XYZ degrees and offset
pose.rs:160–188,210–270: public Pivots ranges and pose panels; endpoint clipping does not repair a reversed range and a nonidentity panel move indexes that slice
garment-fit/lib.rs:478–500: Fit.set_pose computes placed positions, calls write_positions, then retains pose and resets frames only after success
xpbd/particles.rs:86–115,123–136 and particles/packed.rs:23–45: cardinality/capacity checks and position packing but no per-coordinate finite check on this displayed write path
findings_and_refinements.conditions: A nonfinite value explicitly supplied as a move, or a caller-supplied reversed pivot range with a nonidentity corresponding panel move, is a source-level conditional ingress. Real caller, native output, validation and actual failure not demonstrated. The old F088 carries both examples; this report is not a new finding.
findings_and_refinements.repair_direction_future: Preserve valid signed translations, XYZ order, finite unwrapped Euler angles and short/empty panel identity while admitting actual pose/geometry and mesh-associated ranges before retained state and native indexing. Cross-system design, implementation and acceptance remain future work.

findings_and_refinements.status: Source-backed conditional refinement connected to F088 and prior /root/mhr_character cloth-mesh question; unique count/alias reserved for central reconciliation.
trace: garment/mod.rs:128–180: public panel_names determine panel_count, public panel_offsets are indexed to construct each range
pose.rs:176–187: Pivots::of immediately slices positions by that range
garment-fit/lib.rs:218–223,389–435: public GarmentBuild carries a GarmentMesh and Fit.new invokes Pivots::of after Cloth.new
cloth/mod.rs:27–46 and shell/mesh.rs:8–19,85–129: Cloth forwards positions and solver fields into ShellMesh, which has no panel offsets/names and cannot validate this panel association
garment/mod.rs:271–291: ordinary builder pushes each panel offset and final total, subject to separate u32 cast and capacity questions
findings_and_refinements.condition: A caller constructs or mutates a mesh whose name count lacks corresponding offsets, or whose offsets form a reversed or out-of-bounds slice. The public Pivots::of reaches indexing/slicing directly; in Fit.new that point is reached only if earlier device and cloth construction succeed. No malformed mesh or Fit execution occurred; no real producer is shown to create it.
findings_and_refinements.relationship: Original F088 already requests validating mesh-associated ordered pivot ranges and includes a reversed supplied Pivots range. This trace identifies an earlier producer-to-pivot association boundary, not an automatically independent issue. Existing /root/mhr_character cloth-garment packet explicitly left public mesh/Pivots association open.

findings_and_refinements.status: New source-level mathematical refinement related to F088 and prior extreme-finite geometry question; no unique count or supported-input reachability asserted.
trace: pose.rs:197–207: nonempty bounding box center is (lowest + highest)*0.5
pose.rs:64–70,176–184,250–267: resulting pivots enter move subtraction, XYZ rotation and translation
garment/mod.rs:39–65: rotate_xyz performs f32 angle and component operations
garment-fit/lib.rs:493–500, xpbd/particles/packed.rs:26–45: accepted pose reaches cardinality-checked packing before retained pose on successful writes
findings_and_refinements.condition: With a finite coordinate at f32::MAX for both low and high bounds, the sum overflows to infinity in f32 before halving. Applying a finite nonidentity translation with zero angles to such a point uses the infinite pivot and may propagate nonfinite components through subtraction, IEEE infinity-times-zero and addition. This is mathematical source reasoning, not a generated mesh, floating-point probe or product run. Supported coordinate magnitude and actual producer/device reachability remain unknown.
findings_and_refinements.relationship: F088 concerns nonfinite pose input and validation of actual placed geometry. This refinement starts with finite bounds and identifies the earlier center arithmetic; /root/mhr_character’s cloth-garment report left extreme finite coordinates and precision open. Whether one checked geometry/pose policy resolves all cases is a central repair/alias question.
findings_and_refinements.future_direction: Once supported coordinate bounds are defined, use a numerically defensible midpoint and ensure transformed geometry is admitted before native write; test design and validation only in an authorized later phase.

nonfindings: A short or empty panel-move list intentionally means identity for remaining panels; no missing-identity compatibility defect.
The ordinary builder emits one offset per panel plus a final total, so the malformed-mesh example is conditional on a different or modified public value and separate count/capacity policy.
Pivots and pose consumers use positional panel indices/ranges; do not extend 059 q316 named-panel string ownership finding into these APIs without independent evidence (q3438).

Rigid moves are recomputed from retained unposed base positions; successful set_pose writes current and previous positions and zero velocities according to the inspected source. This is not runtime or partial-write atomicity proof.
open_questions: Which callers may construct or mutate GarmentMesh and Pivots and what supported coordinate, panel-count and association policy is intended?
Can supported normal geometry approach f32 midpoint overflow, and should valid coordinates remain bounded before or after XYZ movement?
How should earlier F088, this upstream mesh-association trace, finite-operation overflow and separate cloth count findings be reconciled without duplicate counting?
What are actual device write failure and partial-update semantics? No GPU operation was executed.

thirteen_lenses.producer-propagation: GarmentMesh panel metadata produces pivots; Pose transforms retained base geometry to particle packing. Public and normal-builder producer paths differ.
thirteen_lenses.existing-type-owners: GarmentMesh owns panel offsets, Pivots associates ranges and centers, and Move owns translations and angles; all require actual owner coordination.
thirteen_lenses.admission-contracts: Public moves and pivots do not by themselves certify finite transformed geometry or mesh-associated valid ranges; F088 already records this family.
thirteen_lenses.invariant-operations: Finite bounding-box endpoints can overflow in midpoint addition; endpoint-wise range clamping does not establish start <= end.
thirteen_lenses.aggregate-states: Panel names, offsets, positions and Pivots must correspond; ShellMesh validation covers different data and is not a panel-metadata certificate.
thirteen_lenses.wrong-duplicate-owners: Cloth owns mesh layout, pose owns placement, and shell owns solver geometry; avoid forcing a single owner solely from shared numeric representation.
thirteen_lenses.redundant-authority: Retained original base positions and derived pivot centers intentionally describe one original mesh; public replacement and extreme arithmetic need independent admission.
thirteen_lenses.behavior-preservation: Preserve signed metres, XYZ angles/order, allowed short pose lists, base-relative re-placement and normal panel ordering in any future repair.
thirteen_lenses.enum-state-shape: Axis is a six-way closed control with labels and units; optional panel values intentionally mean identity rather than an error variant.
thirteen_lenses.derivability: Move/Pivots defaults are valid identity or empty views; deriving defaults does not prove a custom mesh association or finite application.
thirteen_lenses.granularity: Panel positions/ranges, body-space offsets and Euler degrees have distinct roles; positional panel references do not imply PanelName propagation.
thirteen_lenses.raw-strings: Axis labels and unit strings are final UI presentation, not private authority; no named-panel string finding is inferred in pose.rs.
thirteen_lenses.raw-primitives: Metres, degrees, panel indices and raw f32 bounds have distinct policies; finite input alone does not guarantee finite midpoint or transformed output.

limitations: Evidence checks and mathematical reasoning only; no geometry, renderer, solver, product, tests, probes, repairs, builds or source/publication changes. Historical reviewer attribution, original revision, reconstructed records and checkpoint qualifications remain explicit.
